# Security reporting

[English](SECURITY.md) | [简体中文](../docs/zh-CN/SECURITY.md)

This policy covers source, extension packages, and scripts in this public repository. An individual maintains the project without response-time, bug-bounty, or ongoing-support commitments. There is no formal supported-version list.

Send suspected vulnerabilities privately to **destiniye2008@gmail.com** in Chinese or English. Do not disclose details in public issues, pull requests, or discussions. Include affected versions, impact, minimal reproduction steps, and a possible fix if available. For extension issues, include the browser version. Prefer synthetic data.

Do not include real chats, account UIDs, recruiter contacts, complete exports or logs, databases, Cookies, verification codes, pairing tokens, private keys, or other account-access information. Reduce sensitive reproductions to the smallest redacted example that demonstrates the problem.

The maintainer assesses reports as time allows, without guaranteed acknowledgement or fix deadlines. Allow reasonable time for assessment and remediation before disclosure.
